description: PCDACore Pluggable Domain Lenses Schema & Profiles

lenses.name: Developer Ergonomics
lenses.prompt: Evaluate cognitive load, API elegance, and daily developer velocity.

lenses.name: Industry SOTA & Precedents
lenses.prompt: Compare with modern state-of-the-art architectures and existing precedents.

lenses.name: Architecture & Coupling
lenses.prompt: Analyze modularity, blast radius, separation of concerns, and coupling.

lenses.name: Long-Term Sustainability
lenses.prompt: Assess maintenance burden, technical debt, and 6-month failure modes.

lenses.name: Audio Thread Real-Time Safety
lenses.prompt: Verify zero heap allocations, zero blocking locks, and zero I/O on the audio thread.

lenses.name: CPU & SIMD Vectorization Cost
lenses.prompt: Evaluate per-sample compute budget, transcendental math, and vectorization.

lenses.name: Aliasing & Sound Quality
lenses.prompt: Check oversampling, bandlimiting (PolyBLEP/minBLEP), and phase response.

lenses.name: UI/Audio Thread Decoupling & Latency
lenses.prompt: Ensure lock-free parameter queues and 60fps responsive UI without audio drops.

lenses.name: Signal Flow, Latency & Jitter
lenses.prompt: Audit analog/digital conversion latency, MIDI clock jitter, and gain staging.

lenses.name: Physical Ergonomics & Reach
lenses.prompt: Evaluate desk real estate, knob spacing, patching speed, and screen glare.

lenses.name: Power, Ground Loops & Noise Floor
lenses.prompt: Check mA draw across +12V/-12V/+5V rails, ripple, USB ground loops, and isolation.

lenses.name: BOM Cost, Resale & Build Effort
lenses.prompt: Assess bill of materials, availability, build difficulty, and gear longevity.

lenses.name: Narrative Resonance & Theme
lenses.prompt: Evaluate emotional impact, thematic coherence, and tone.

lenses.name: Player/Reader Agency
lenses.prompt: Ensure meaningful choices, avoid railroad traps, and reward curiosity.

lenses.name: Systems Balance & Ludonarrative
lenses.prompt: Check mechanical equilibrium, exploit vectors, and mechanics matching lore.

lenses.name: Elegance & Occam's Razor
lenses.prompt: Eliminate superfluous rules, convoluted systems, and excessive bloat.

lenses.name: Air-Gap Data Boundary & Zero-Leakage
lenses.prompt: Verify that all inference and context processing remain strictly within the local, air-gapped enclave. Audit for external network calls, remote telemetry, model checkpoint persistence, or prompt caching that could expose member/patient data.

lenses.name: HIPAA Safe Harbor & Data Minimization
lenses.prompt: Enforce strict data minimization and de-identification (Safe Harbor 18 identifiers: names, dates, claim IDs, MRNs, SSNs, geographic subdivisions). Verify synthetic data masking, tokenization, or zero-retention policies prior to context ingestion.

lenses.name: Claims Adjudication & Clinical Hallucination Risk
lenses.prompt: Stress-test for hallucinations in benefit matrices, EDI 837/835/270/271 schemas, CPT/ICD-10/HCPCS codes, prior authorization logic, and accumulators. Ensure the system never fabricates clinical criteria, medical necessity guidelines, or coverage determinations.

lenses.name: Regulatory Compliance, BAA & Audit Drift
lenses.prompt: Audit immutable access logging, Business Associate Agreement (BAA) boundaries, CMS/HITECH compliance, and model drift over time to guarantee deterministic, auditable decisions in production healthcare environments.
